kaikki_vikisozluk.e: ذَا • (ḏā) m sg (feminine ذِي or ذِهِ or تِهِ or تِي, or obsolete ذَاتَ, masculine dual ذَانِ, feminine dual تَانِ, plural أُولَاءِ (ʔulāʔi) or أُولَى (ʔulā))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Inherited from Proto-Semitic *ḏV- (“this”). Cognates include Ge'ez ዝ (zə), Amharic ይህ (yəh) and Hebrew זה.
